#comment: Concatenate every codex/config.toml found in the XDG config search path,
then every config.toml under CODEX_EXTRA_CONFIG_DIRS, and mount the result
as the container user's Codex config.
Addons may set or extend CODEX_EXTRA_CONFIG_DIRS after key 0 and before 100.
CODEX_HOME is also required for Codex to read the AGENTS.md mounted there

100: # using /etc/codex/config.toml because codex wants to imperatively manage ~/.codex/config.toml and complains when it can't, and to keep static persistent user settings with programatically and imperatively managed state...
# Mounting read/write would be similar, but disallow persisting the programatically managed config in a mounted home dir.
# Maybe I should disallow that persistent state, but I'll make that decision separately.
# I've had issues with codex loading the ~/.codex/AGENTS.md file if I don't set this.
